examples.label: Storage quota warning pinned bottom left
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-toast" site="Global" id="toast-storage-quota" variant="default" color="warning" vertical="bottom" horizontal="left" width="large" padding="small">
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-server-stack" class="size-5 shrink-0" />

You have used 92% of your storage

examples.label: Connection lost notice centred at the bottom
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-toast" site="Global" id="toast-connection-lost" variant="default" color="dark" vertical="bottom" horizontal="center" width="medium" padding="small">
<.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-signal-slash" class="size-5 shrink-0" />

You are offline. Edits will sync once the connection returns.
